package personalteacher

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// EnsureSoul creates the PersonalTeacher aggregate when necessary and returns
// the independently stored soul for the authenticated student.
type EnsureSoul struct {
	Teachers repository.PersonalTeacher
	IDs      IDGenerator
	Clock    Clock
}

func (uc EnsureSoul) Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if studentID == "" || uc.Teachers == nil || uc.IDs == nil || uc.Clock == nil {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, errors.New("invalid ensure teacher soul request")
	}
	now := uc.Clock.Now()
	teacher, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher(
		uc.IDs.NewID(), studentID, domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), now,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, err
	}
	soul, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(teacher.ID, studentID, domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, err
	}
	_, storedSoul, err := uc.Teachers.Ensure(ctx, teacher, soul)
	return storedSoul, err
}

// GetSoul loads an existing per-student soul without creating an aggregate.
type GetSoul struct {
	Teachers repository.PersonalTeacher
}

func (uc GetSoul) Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if studentID == "" || uc.Teachers == nil {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, errors.New("invalid get teacher soul request")
	}
	return uc.Teachers.GetSoulByStudentID(ctx, studentID)
}

// UpdateSoul changes only the bounded personality/relationship settings. It
// cannot write learning state, conversation history, or pedagogical evidence.
type UpdateSoul struct {
	Teachers repository.PersonalTeacher
	Clock    Clock
}

func (uc UpdateSoul) Execute(ctx context.Context, input UpdateSoulInput) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	if input.StudentID == "" || input.ExpectedVersion <= 0 || uc.Teachers == nil || uc.Clock == nil {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, errors.New("invalid update teacher soul request")
	}
	soul, err := uc.Teachers.GetSoulByStudentID(ctx, input.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, err
	}
	settings := soul.Settings()
	applySoulUpdate(&settings, input)
	if err := soul.UpdateSettings(settings, input.ExpectedVersion, uc.Clock.Now()); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, err
	}
	return uc.Teachers.UpdateSoul(ctx, soul, input.ExpectedVersion)
}

func applySoulUpdate(settings *domain.TeacherSoulSettings, input UpdateSoulInput) {
	if input.DisplayName != nil {
		settings.DisplayName = *input.DisplayName
	}
	if input.PersonaCode != nil {
		settings.PersonaCode = *input.PersonaCode
	}
	if input.VoiceStyle != nil {
		settings.VoiceStyle = *input.VoiceStyle
	}
	if input.RelationshipStyle != nil {
		settings.RelationshipStyle = *input.RelationshipStyle
	}
	if input.EncouragementStyle != nil {
		settings.EncouragementStyle = *input.EncouragementStyle
	}
}
